ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity (white) fields occupy the lateral lobes. A large, central low-intensity (black) contiguous region extends from the peduncle attachment to the median notch, with irregular, mottled projections into the white fields. Focal dark pixel clusters are visible at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 70-degree vertex angle; apex is centered along the longitudinal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude varies between 3 to 12 pixels; notable jagged peak-valley sequence on the inner left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve following the trailing edge from notch to tip, exhibiting a sharp posterior-to-anterior sweep at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small (2-5 pixel diameter) high-contrast white circular spots distributed across the lower-central dark pigmentation area, consistent with sessile organism attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Vertical, parallel dark linear pixel disruptions visible within the dark central region adjacent to the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct irregular notch/lesion on the medial trailing edge of the left lobe; visible fraying and potential tissue loss at the terminal point of the right fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A sharp, high-contrast white 'Y' or 'V' shaped mark is isolated within the dark pigmentation on the left side of the median notch.
